title: Abeon App Descriptor
description: Self-registration metadata POSTed by each service to Auth on bootstrap (M4).

order.description: Sort hint within the switcher / category (ascending).

mode.description: Chrome UI mode the app prefers.

status.description: The state of this organisation's instance of the application (ADR-0031 §5): `ready` once it is serving, `provisioning` while it is being created, `failed` when creating it did not finish. Absent on self-registration and for an application the organisation does not hold. An application is only reachable when it is `ready`; the launcher shows the other states rather than a link that would 404.

enabled.description:
Whether this application is assigned to the caller's organisation — the presence of a `tenant_apps` row for (org_id, app). ADR-0015 as amended by ADR-0016.

Organisation-relative: the SAME app yields different values for different callers, so a cached catalogue must be re-derived when the active organisation changes (ADR-0017). Populated by Auth on catalog/apps responses; null/ignored on self-registration, where the app cannot know which organisations hold it.
